evidence: Advancements in, and increased adoption of, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, automation, and other advanced technologies may result in a long-term competitive disadvantage.

Hubbell is increasingly evaluating, developing, or utilizing artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning, automation, and data driven analytics technologies, whether internally, embedded in third party software products, or integrated into customer facing solutions.
The use of AI technologies introduces additional risks related to system reliability, data integrity, transparency, governance, and security.
AI enabled systems may also increase the Company's exposure to cybersecurity, data privacy, and intellectual property risks.
We are subject to risks surrounding our information technology systems and industrial controls systems failures, and the use of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.
ai_positioning.summary: Hubbell est un beneficiaire indirect majeur du boom IA via la demande de produits electriques pour data centers (transformateurs, distribution power, connectivite). Le segment Utility Solutions et Electrical Solutions fournit l'infrastructure backbone des data centers hyperscale. Sans developper d'IA propre, Hubbell capitalise sur la thematique infrastructure IA comme demand driver structurel.

company_description: Hubbell Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells electrical and utility solutions in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Electrical Solutions and Utility Solutions. The Utility Solution segment offers critical components that allow the grid to transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies, including  utility transmission and distribution components, such as arresters, insulators, connectors, anchors, bushings, enclosures, cutouts, and switches; and solutions that serve the edge of the utility infrastructure comprising smart meters, communications systems, and protection and control devices. It sells its products under various brands and/or trademarks to the electrical distribution, substation and transmission markets, as well as markets for grid protection and controls, utility meters and advanced metering infrastructure and telcom and gas distribution markets. The Electrical Solution segment offers standard and special application wiring device products, rough-in electrical products, connector and grounding products, and other electrical equipment for use in industrial, commercial, and institutional facilities by electrical contractors, maintenance personnel, electricians, utilities, and telecommunications companies. It also designs and manufactures various industrial controls, and communication systems for use in the non-residential and industrial markets, as well as in the oil and gas, and mining industries. This segment sells its products through electrical and industrial distributors, home centers, retail and hardware outlets, and residential product-oriented internet sites; and special application products primarily through wholesale distributors to contractors, industrial customers, and original equipment manufacturers. The company was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Shelton, Connecticut.

revenue_by_customer_type.rationale: Hubbell est un fabricant de solutions électriques et d'infrastructure énergétique destinées exclusivement aux clients professionnels. Le segment Utility Solutions (63% des revenus) vend aux utilities et distributeurs d'électricité, tandis que le segment Electrical Solutions (37%) cible les entrepreneurs électriciens, installations industrielles et commerciales. Aucune activité grand public ou IA significative.

overrides_hero_kpi.label: Revenu segment Utility Solutions
overrides_hero_kpi.rationale_segment_specific: The 'Revenu segment Utility Solutions' corresponds directly to the 'Utility Solutions' segment net sales line in the Industry Segment Data table within the MD&A, which reports revenue for the Utility Solutions business unit.

_hero_specific_rationale: Revenu du segment Utility Solutions est un chiffre d'affaires par segment, introduit après une réorganisation ou acquisition récente. Ce type de KPI n'est pas disponible sur 5 ans car il correspond à une segmentation récente des activités de HUBB.

risks_rationale_overrides.title: Changements dans les politiques commerciales internationales
risks_rationale_overrides.score_rationale: Ce risque est positionné en dernier (risk #4 sur 4 dans Item 1A), ce qui suggère une priorité moindre (1). L'intensité du langage est moyenne avec "augmentent les coûts" et "menacent", indiquant un impact possible mais non certain (2). Il est stable par rapport à l'année précédente, sans aggravation ni atténuation notable (3). La catégorie Trade a un poids faible comparé aux risques cyber ou réglementaires (4). Ces éléments justifient un score modéré de 3 sur 5.

hero_kpi_replaced_reason: Hero segment quarterly contaminé (valeur=CA total). Repointé sur Utility Solutions Net Sales (annuel, segment vérifié 10-K).

risks.title: Conditions économiques et inflation
risks.summary: Inflation, taux d'intérêt et ralentissement construction pesant sur la demande.
risks.score_rationale: « inflation and other unfavorable economic conditions may adversely affect » (Tête d'Item 1A, section Industry and Economic Risks). En tête d'Item 1A; exposition directe à la construction non-résidentielle et infrastructure électrique.

risks.title: Politiques commerciales et tarifs
risks.summary: Tarifs et politique commerciale US affectant les composants et exports.
risks.score_rationale: « changes in U.S. trade policies could have a material adverse effect » (Section Trade, langage "material adverse effect"). Tarifs et politique commerciale US actifs; formulation matériellement adverse, exposition composants importés.

risks.title: Concurrence et pression sur les prix
risks.summary: Concurrence intense en distribution électrique et solutions utilities.
risks.score_rationale: « adversely affect our ability to compete » (Section Business and Operational, langage conditionnel). Concurrence Eaton/Schneider/nVent en produits électriques; formulation standard sans exposition chiffrée.

risks.title: Chaîne d'approvisionnement et devises
risks.summary: Volatilité des devises affectant les résultats convertis.
risks.score_rationale: « volatility in currency exchange rates may adversely affect our financial condition » (Section International, langage conditionnel). Exposition devises modérée pour un industriel US; formulation standard.

risks.title: Cybersécurité et systèmes internes
risks.summary: Failles de sécurité IT ou perturbations lors de migrations ERP.
risks.score_rationale: « these system modifications and implementations could result in operating inefficiencies » (Section Operations, langage prudentiel). Standard secteur industriel; formulation prudentielle sans incident matériel cité.

risks.title: Intégration d'acquisitions et dépréciations
risks.summary: Charges de dépréciation goodwill si les acquisitions déçoivent.
risks.score_rationale: « any charges relating to such impairments could adversely affect our results » (Section Acquisitions, langage conditionnel). Historique acquisitions actif (Systems Control, Ventev, DMC Power); risque impairment goodwill standard.

risks.title: Fiscalité internationale (Pillar 2)
risks.summary: Cadre fiscal international (Pillar 2, minimum global) affectant le taux effectif.
risks.score_rationale: « evolving international tax frameworks may adversely affect our global tax position » (Section Legal, Tax and Regulatory, langage prudentiel). Formulation prudentielle sans exposition chiffrée; Pillar 2 déjà provisionné pour la plupart des industriels.

risks.title: Propriété intellectuelle et contrefaçon
risks.summary: Contrefaçons et litiges brevets sur produits électriques.
risks.score_rationale: « we may incur significant costs that could adversely affect our results » (Bas d'Item 1A, langage prudentiel standard). Boilerplate IP secteur industriel, position basse; pas de litige matériel spécifique.
